must_not: The Member request to renew or pause a plan landing on the wrong day, counted twice, or missing from both days

note: 'Today' is the India day; requests older than 30 days unseen stop showing

start: Admin app, the requests list; a member asked to pause

steps.action: Open the request (member's name from the gym's list)
user_sees: Name, dates asked, and buttons to approve or decline
must_not: A request of another gym
'A member' when the gym's list has the name

steps.action: Approve: the panel runs 'Freeze / extra days' for those dates, then marks it approved
user_sees: The request approved, with the plan's new end date
must_not: The request approved without the plan changed (NOT_DONE is the refusal)
The end date moved twice

steps.action: Tap the main button of step 2 of "Member asks to pause or renew their plan from the app; the desk approves or decl" twice, fast.
user_sees: One result; the button shows it is busy
must_not: Two rows of Member request to renew or pause a plan, two charges, two messages sent, or two screens opened

note: One waiting request per kind; decide twice = same answer
